TTMIK sometimes posts shorts of conversational Korean translated into English but maintaining Korean word order (What English would sound like with Korean grammar), which I personally find really helpful, and yeah, the Yoda comment does come up with some frequency!

It makes sense, I guess, since grammar/word order (SVO/SOV/OSV/topic-prominent language word orders) being applied differently from the norm in any language is a big part of what makes someone sound "other", and that was part of the character design shorthand for Yoda.
